**Location:** Tirupathur, Tamil Nadu

**Education:** B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc./BCA/MCA or relevant qualification

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated **Web Developer** to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving websites and web applications while working closely with the internal team.

Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain responsive websites and web applications.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Build and improve website features based on business requirements.
* Identify and fix bugs and technical issues.
* Ensure websites are responsive and user\-friendly.
* Optimize website performance and loading speed.
* Test websites across different browsers and devices.
* Collaborate with designers and other team members.
* Maintain and update existing websites.
* Stay updated with current web development technologies.

Requirements

* Basic knowledge of **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**.
* Familiarity with frontend or backend development is an advantage.
* Knowledge of **React, Node.js, PHP, Python, or similar technologies** is a plus.
* Basic understanding of databases and APIs.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on real\-world web development projects.
* Learning and professional growth opportunities.
* Supportive and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity for freshers to develop practical technical skills. How to Apply

jobs.title: Junior backend developer intern
jobs.description:
Join **archintX** and gain hands\-on experience building reliable backend systems and APIs for an AI\-powered education and career platform.

What You’ll Work On

* Develop backend features using **Python and Django**.
* Build and integrate **REST APIs** using Django REST Framework.
* Work with databases such as **PostgreSQL and MySQL**.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable backend code.
* Debug issues, fix bugs, and improve application performance.
* Implement authentication, data validation, and secure API practices.
* Collaborate with frontend, mobile, QA, and product teams.
* Use **Git and GitHub** for version control and collaboration.

What You’ll Learn

* Real\-world **Python and Django backend development**.
* REST API development and database integration.
* Backend testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Authentication and secure application development.
* Modern backend development practices and workflows.
* How backend systems support AI\-powered products and platforms.

Who We’re Looking For

Students interested in **Python, Django, backend development, REST APIs, databases, and problem\-solving**. Prior project experience is a plus, but strong programming fundamentals and willingness to learn are most important.

**Your mission:** Build secure and reliable backend solutions that power the archintX learning and career platform.

Pay: Up to ₹5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chengalpattu, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
